## `neuro.bigInt.asUintN`

Static method on `BigInt`.

> Interprets the low bits of a BigInt as an unsigned integer.
> All higher bits are discarded.

## Signatures

```ts
asUintN(input: { bits: number; int: bigint; prompt?: string }): Promise<bigint>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `BigInt.asUintN` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
